name: Enable Game Mode
description: Windows Game Mode on for better game scheduling.
detailedDescription: Windows Game Mode on for better game scheduling.

name: Disable Xbox Game DVR
description: Stops background recording (real FPS drain).
detailedDescription: Stops background recording (real FPS drain).
originalCommand: reg add "HKCU\System\GameConfigStore" /v GameDVR_Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR" /v AllowGameDVR /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKCU\System\GameConfigStore" /v GameDVR_Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f & reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR" /v AllowGameDVR /f

name: Disable Game Bar Capture
description: Turns off Win+G background capture.
detailedDescription: Turns off Win+G background capture.

name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations
description: Global FSO off for lower input lag (test per game).
detailedDescription: Global FSO off for lower input lag (test per game).
originalCommand: reg add "HKCU\System\GameConfigStore" /v GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f & reg add "HKCU\System\GameConfigStore" /v GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
originalRevert: reg delete "HKCU\System\GameConfigStore" /v GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode /f & reg delete "HKCU\System\GameConfigStore" /v GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode /f

name: Disable Mouse Acceleration
description: Raw, consistent aim (turns off pointer precision).
detailedDescription: Raw, consistent aim (turns off pointer precision).
originalCommand: reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseSpeed /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f & reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseThreshold1 /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f & reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseThreshold2 /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseSpeed /t REG_SZ /d 1 /f & reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseThreshold1 /t REG_SZ /d 6 /f & reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseThreshold2 /t REG_SZ /d 10 /f

name: Visual Effects: Performance
description: Disables animations/shadows for a snappier desktop.
detailedDescription: Disables animations/shadows for a snappier desktop.

name: Disable Transparency
description: Turns off transparency effects (tiny GPU/CPU save).
detailedDescription: Turns off transparency effects (tiny GPU/CPU save).

name: Remove Menu Show Delay
description: Menus open instantly instead of after 400ms.
detailedDescription: Menus open instantly instead of after 400ms.

name: Remove Startup Delay
description: Autostart apps launch immediately.
detailedDescription: Autostart apps launch immediately.

name: Show File Extensions
description: Always show file extensions in Explorer.
detailedDescription: Always show file extensions in Explorer.

name: Disable Fast Startup
description: Cleaner full shutdowns (fixes some driver quirks). Booting takes longer, because Windows starts cold instead of resuming a saved kernel.
detailedDescription: Cleaner full shutdowns (fixes some driver quirks). Booting takes longer, because Windows starts cold instead of resuming a saved kernel.

name: Disable Core Isolation (HVCI)
description: RISKY: lowers security (memory integrity). Can raise FPS. Reboot.
detailedDescription: RISKY: lowers security (memory integrity). Can raise FPS. Reboot.

name: Disable VBS
description: RISKY: disables Virtualization-Based Security. Reboot.
detailedDescription: RISKY: disables Virtualization-Based Security. Reboot.

name: Hardware GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
description: Reboot required. Can lower latency - test on your rig.
detailedDescription: Reboot required. Can lower latency - test on your rig.

name: Disable MPO
description: Fixes flicker/stutter on some NVIDIA/AMD setups. Driver-dependent: on setups where the overlay was working it can introduce the stutter it fixes elsewhere. Undo it if the picture gets worse.
detailedDescription: Fixes flicker/stutter on some NVIDIA/AMD setups. Driver-dependent: on setups where the overlay was working it can introduce the stutter it fixes elsewhere. Undo it if the picture gets worse.

name: Increase TdrDelay
description: Fewer 'display driver stopped responding' timeouts. If the GPU really does hang, you now stare at a frozen screen for ten seconds instead of two before Windows resets the driver.
detailedDescription: Fewer 'display driver stopped responding' timeouts. If the GPU really does hang, you now stare at a frozen screen for ten seconds instead of two before Windows resets the driver.

name: Ultimate Performance Plan
description: Creates & activates the Ultimate Performance power plan.
detailedDescription: Creates & activates the Ultimate Performance power plan.

operations.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$o=powercfg -duplicatescheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61; $g=([regex]'([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})').Match($o).Value; if($g){powercfg -setactive $g}"

name: Min Processor State 100%
description: Keeps CPU from downclocking (more consistent frames). The CPU never clocks down, so it runs hotter, draws more power at idle and the fans stay louder.
detailedDescription: Keeps CPU from downclocking (more consistent frames). The CPU never clocks down, so it runs hotter, draws more power at idle and the fans stay louder.
originalCommand: powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 100 & powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
originalRevert: powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 5 & powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

name: Disable Core Parking
description: Keeps all cores active (core parking, not C-states). Every core stays awake, which costs idle power and heat for a gain most games will not notice.
detailedDescription: Keeps all cores active (core parking, not C-states). Every core stays awake, which costs idle power and heat for a gain most games will not notice.
originalCommand: powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR CPMINCORES 100 & powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
originalRevert: powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR CPMINCORES 0 & powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

name: Disable Power Throttling
description: Stops Windows throttling the CPU under load. Higher power draw and more heat under load, and on a laptop noticeably less battery.
detailedDescription: Stops Windows throttling the CPU under load. Higher power draw and more heat under load, and on a laptop noticeably less battery.

name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
description: No USB standby (mouse/keyboard lag). USB devices are kept powered at all times, which costs a little idle power and battery.
detailedDescription: No USB standby (mouse/keyboard lag). USB devices are kept powered at all times, which costs a little idle power and battery.

name: Foreground Priority Boost
description: Win32PrioritySeparation = 26 (favors the active app). Background work is starved while a game is in focus: downloads, encodes and compiles slow down.
detailedDescription: Win32PrioritySeparation = 26 (favors the active app). Background work is starved while a game is in focus: downloads, encodes and compiles slow down.

name: System Responsiveness for Games
description: Gives games more CPU headroom (MMCSS = 0). Nothing is held back for background services any more, so heavy load can make recording or voice chat stutter.
detailedDescription: Gives games more CPU headroom (MMCSS = 0). Nothing is held back for background services any more, so heavy load can make recording or voice chat stutter.

name: Keep Kernel in RAM
description: DisablePagingExecutive - needs plenty of RAM.
detailedDescription: DisablePagingExecutive - needs plenty of RAM.
originalCommand: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v DisablePagingExecutive /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v DisablePagingExecutive /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

name: Disable Dynamic Tick
description: Timer tweak that can smooth frame pacing.
detailedDescription: Timer tweak that can smooth frame pacing.

operations.command: bcdedit /set disabledynamictick yes

name: HPET off (useplatformclock)
description: RISKY/TEST: can help or hurt - always benchmark.
detailedDescription: RISKY/TEST: can help or hurt - always benchmark.

operations.command: bcdedit /set useplatformclock false

name: Disable Spectre/Meltdown Mitigations
description: RISKY: turns off CPU security mitigations for small perf.
detailedDescription: RISKY: turns off CPU security mitigations for small perf.
originalCommand: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v FeatureSettingsOverride /t REG_DWORD /d 3 /f

name: Disable Background Apps
description: Stops UWP apps running in the background.
detailedDescription: Stops UWP apps running in the background.

name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
description: Can reduce disk churn (marginal on SSD).
detailedDescription: Can reduce disk churn (marginal on SSD).
originalCommand: sc config SysMain start= disabled & sc stop SysMain
originalRevert: sc config SysMain start= auto & sc start SysMain

name: Disable Prefetch (SSD only)
description: Only for SSDs. Do NOT use on HDDs.
detailedDescription: Only for SSDs. Do NOT use on HDDs.
originalCommand: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters" /v EnablePrefetcher /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters" /v EnablePrefetcher /t REG_DWORD /d 3 /f

name: Disable Nagle's Algorithm
description: TcpAckFrequency/TCPNoDelay on every interface.
detailedDescription: TcpAckFrequency/TCPNoDelay on every interface.

operations.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name TcpAckFrequency -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name TCPNoDelay -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force }"

originalCommand: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name TcpAckFrequency -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name TCPNoDelay -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force }"
originalRevert: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Remove-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name TcpAckFrequency -EA 0; Remove-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name TCPNoDelay -EA 0 }"

name: Disable Network Throttling
description: Lifts the 10ms multimedia network throttle. Removes the throttle that protects audio and video playback from network interrupt load; under heavy traffic playback can stutter.
detailedDescription: Lifts the 10ms multimedia network throttle. Removes the throttle that protects audio and video playback from network interrupt load; under heavy traffic playback can stutter.

name: Free QoS Reserved Bandwidth
description: Removes the 20% reserved bandwidth limit.
detailedDescription: Removes the 20% reserved bandwidth limit.

name: TCP Auto-Tuning + RSS
description: Balanced low-latency TCP settings.
detailedDescription: Balanced low-latency TCP settings.
originalCommand: netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal & netsh int tcp set global rss=enabled
originalRevert: netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal & netsh int tcp set global rss=enabled

name: Disable ECN
description: Turns off Explicit Congestion Notification. Congestion is then signalled by dropped packets instead of a marker, which on a busy line can be the worse trade.
detailedDescription: Turns off Explicit Congestion Notification. Congestion is then signalled by dropped packets instead of a marker, which on a busy line can be the worse trade.
originalCommand: netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled
originalRevert: netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=enabled

name: Disable Delivery Optimization
description: Stops Windows Update P2P using your bandwidth.
detailedDescription: Stops Windows Update P2P using your bandwidth.

name: DNS to Cloudflare (1.1.1.1)
description: OPTIONAL: sets DNS on all active adapters.
detailedDescription: OPTIONAL: sets DNS on all active adapters.

operations.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetAdapter | ? Status -eq 'Up' | % { Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $_.ifIndex -ServerAddresses ('1.1.1.1','1.0.0.1') }"

name: Clean Temp Files
description: Deletes %TEMP% and C:\Windows\Temp.
detailedDescription: Deletes %TEMP% and C:\Windows\Temp.

name: Empty Recycle Bin
description: Empties the Windows Recycle Bin.
detailedDescription: Empties the Windows Recycle Bin.

operations.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"

name: Clear Prefetch
description: Removes cached prefetch files.
detailedDescription: Removes cached prefetch files.

name: Flush DNS Cache
description: ipconfig /flushdns.
detailedDescription: ipconfig /flushdns.

operations.command: ipconfig /flushdns

name: Disable Reserved Storage
description: Frees ~7 GB reserved for updates.
detailedDescription: Frees ~7 GB reserved for updates.

operations.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "DISM /Online /Set-ReservedStorageState /State:Disabled"

name: Disable Hibernate (free space)
description: Removes hiberfil.sys (= your RAM size in GB). Hibernation and Fast Startup stop working. The space comes back the moment you re-enable it.
detailedDescription: Removes hiberfil.sys (= your RAM size in GB). Hibernation and Fast Startup stop working. The space comes back the moment you re-enable it.

name: Disable Advertising ID
description: No personalized ad tracking.
detailedDescription: No personalized ad tracking.

name: Disable Activity History
description: Stops Windows Timeline / activity feed.
detailedDescription: Stops Windows Timeline / activity feed.

name: Disable Tailored Experiences
description: No suggestions based on diagnostic data.
detailedDescription: No suggestions based on diagnostic data.

name: Disable Web Search in Start
description: Removes Bing/web results from Start search.
detailedDescription: Removes Bing/web results from Start search.

name: Disable Consumer Features
description: Stops auto-installed suggested/bloat apps.
detailedDescription: Stops auto-installed suggested/bloat apps.

name: Disable Location Services
description: Turns off Windows location access.
detailedDescription: Turns off Windows location access.

name: Disable Telemetry (DiagTrack)
description: Stops and disables the telemetry service. Feedback Hub and some Store and Update diagnostics stop working. Company-managed PCs may switch it back on.
detailedDescription: Stops and disables the telemetry service. Feedback Hub and some Store and Update diagnostics stop working. Company-managed PCs may switch it back on.
originalCommand: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v AllowTelemetry /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & sc stop DiagTrack & sc config DiagTrack start= disabled
originalRevert: sc config DiagTrack start= auto & sc start DiagTrack

name: Disable PCIe Power Saving (ASPM)
description: Stops PCIe links dropping to low power (GPU/NIC latency). PCIe links stay at full power, so idle power draw and heat go up.
detailedDescription: Stops PCIe links dropping to low power (GPU/NIC latency). PCIe links stay at full power, so idle power draw and heat go up.

name: Force Platform Tick
description: Uses the platform tick source (pairs with dynamic tick off).
detailedDescription: Uses the platform tick source (pairs with dynamic tick off).

operations.command: bcdedit /set useplatformtick yes

name: Disable CPU Idle States
description: Lowest latency, keeps CPU awake. More heat/power - desktops only. The CPU never idles: markedly more heat and power, and fans that never spin down. Desktops only.
detailedDescription: Lowest latency, keeps CPU awake. More heat/power - desktops only. The CPU never idles: markedly more heat and power, and fans that never spin down. Desktops only.
originalCommand: powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR IDLEDISABLE 1 & powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
originalRevert: powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR IDLEDISABLE 0 & powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

name: Clear Pagefile at Shutdown
description: Wipes the pagefile on shutdown (slower shutdown).
detailedDescription: Wipes the pagefile on shutdown (slower shutdown).
originalCommand: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v ClearPageFileAtShutdown /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v ClearPageFileAtShutdown /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

name: Disable TCP Timestamps
description: Slightly leaner packets. Timestamps help TCP judge round-trip time on long or fast links; without them throughput can drop there.
detailedDescription: Slightly leaner packets. Timestamps help TCP judge round-trip time on long or fast links; without them throughput can drop there.
originalCommand: netsh int tcp set global timestamps=disabled
originalRevert: netsh int tcp set global timestamps=enabled

name: Disable RSC (Receive Coalescing)
description: Lower latency at a tiny CPU cost.
detailedDescription: Lower latency at a tiny CPU cost.
originalCommand: netsh int tcp set global rsc=disabled
originalRevert: netsh int tcp set global rsc=enabled

name: Disable TCP Window Heuristics
description: Keeps your TCP window tuning from being overridden. Windows can no longer adjust the receive window for unusual connections by itself.
detailedDescription: Keeps your TCP window tuning from being overridden. Windows can no longer adjust the receive window for unusual connections by itself.
originalCommand: netsh int tcp set heuristics disabled
originalRevert: netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled

name: Lower TcpTimedWaitDelay
description: Frees closed ports faster (helps many connections). Closed ports are reused sooner, so on a flaky line a late packet from an old connection can land on a new one.
detailedDescription: Frees closed ports faster (helps many connections). Closed ports are reused sooner, so on a flaky line a late packet from an old connection can land on a new one.

name: Raise MaxUserPort
description: More outbound ports available. Costs a little memory for the larger connection table, and changes nothing unless you open thousands of connections.
detailedDescription: More outbound ports available. Costs a little memory for the larger connection table, and changes nothing unless you open thousands of connections.

name: Disable Taskbar Widgets
description: Removes the Widgets button (frees a background process).
detailedDescription: Removes the Widgets button (frees a background process).

name: Disable Window Animations
description: Snappier minimize/maximize.
detailedDescription: Snappier minimize/maximize.

name: Disable Taskbar Animations
description: Removes taskbar animation overhead.
detailedDescription: Removes taskbar animation overhead.

name: Disable Sticky Keys Prompt
description: No accidental Shift x5 popup mid-game.
detailedDescription: No accidental Shift x5 popup mid-game.

name: Clear Windows Update Cache
description: Frees space from old update downloads. Recently installed updates can no longer be uninstalled afterwards, and Windows re-downloads whatever it still needs.
detailedDescription: Frees space from old update downloads. Recently installed updates can no longer be uninstalled afterwards, and Windows re-downloads whatever it still needs.
originalCommand: cmd /c "net stop wuauserv & del /q /f /s %SystemRoot%\SoftwareDistribution\Download\* & net start wuauserv"

name: Clear Thumbnail Cache
description: Deletes cached Explorer thumbnails.
detailedDescription: Deletes cached Explorer thumbnails.

name: Enable Dark Mode
description: Dark theme for apps and system.
detailedDescription: Dark theme for apps and system.
originalCommand: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize" /v AppsUseLightTheme /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize" /v SystemUsesLightTheme /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize" /v AppsUseLightTheme /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize" /v SystemUsesLightTheme /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

name: Disable Aero Shake
description: Stops minimizing windows when you shake one.
detailedDescription: Stops minimizing windows when you shake one.

name: Show Seconds in Clock
description: Taskbar clock shows seconds.
detailedDescription: Taskbar clock shows seconds.

name: Show Hidden Files
description: Show hidden files and folders in Explorer.
detailedDescription: Show hidden files and folders in Explorer.

name: Disable Snap Assist Flyout
description: No popup suggestions when snapping windows.
detailedDescription: No popup suggestions when snapping windows.

name: Disable Recent Files Tracking
description: Stops tracking recently opened documents.
detailedDescription: Stops tracking recently opened documents.

name: Disable AutoPlay
description: No AutoPlay prompts for drives/media.
detailedDescription: No AutoPlay prompts for drives/media.

name: Disable Startup Sound
description: No Windows boot chime.
detailedDescription: No Windows boot chime.

name: Disable Error Reporting
description: Stops Windows Error Reporting popups/uploads.
detailedDescription: Stops Windows Error Reporting popups/uploads.
originalCommand: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

name: Enable Taskbar 'End Task'
description: Adds End Task to the taskbar right-click (Win11).
detailedDescription: Adds End Task to the taskbar right-click (Win11).

name: Verbose Boot Messages
description: Shows detailed status during boot/shutdown. Boot and shutdown show technical status text instead of the plain spinner, which looks alarming if you are not expecting it.
detailedDescription: Shows detailed status during boot/shutdown. Boot and shutdown show technical status text instead of the plain spinner, which looks alarming if you are not expecting it.

name: Disable Lock Screen
description: Skips the lock screen (straight to login). You lose the lock screen with its clock, notifications and background - straight to the password prompt.
detailedDescription: Skips the lock screen (straight to login). You lose the lock screen with its clock, notifications and background - straight to the password prompt.

name: Classic Right-Click Menu (Win11)
description: Restores the full context menu. Restart Explorer after. The Windows 11 menu is gone, including the app entries only it shows. Explorer has to be restarted.
detailedDescription: Restores the full context menu. Restart Explorer after. The Windows 11 menu is gone, including the app entries only it shows. Explorer has to be restarted.

name: No Auto-Reboot on Updates
description: Windows won't force a restart while you're logged in.
detailedDescription: Windows won't force a restart while you're logged in.

name: Disable Cortana
description: Turns off the Cortana assistant.
detailedDescription: Turns off the Cortana assistant.

name: Disable Start Menu Suggestions
description: No suggested apps/ads in the Start menu.
detailedDescription: No suggested apps/ads in the Start menu.

name: Disable Windows Tips
description: Stops 'tips & suggestions' popups.
detailedDescription: Stops 'tips & suggestions' popups.

name: Disable Lock Screen Ads
description: No Spotlight ads/tips on the lock screen.
detailedDescription: No Spotlight ads/tips on the lock screen.
originalCommand: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v SubscribedContent-338387Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v SubscribedContent-338387Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

name: Disable Settings Suggestions
description: No suggested content in the Settings app.
detailedDescription: No suggested content in the Settings app.
originalCommand: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v SubscribedContent-338393Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v SubscribedContent-353694Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v SubscribedContent-353696Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

name: Disable Cloud Clipboard Sync
description: No clipboard syncing across devices.
detailedDescription: No clipboard syncing across devices.

name: Disable Clipboard History
description: Turns off Win+V clipboard history. Win+V stops working, and nothing is kept beyond the single item you copied last.
detailedDescription: Turns off Win+V clipboard history. Win+V stops working, and nothing is kept beyond the single item you copied last.

name: Disable App Diagnostics
description: Blocks apps from reading diagnostic info about other apps.
detailedDescription: Blocks apps from reading diagnostic info about other apps.

name: Disable Feedback Requests
description: Stops Windows asking for feedback.
detailedDescription: Stops Windows asking for feedback.
originalCommand: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules" /v NumberOfSIUFInPeriod /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
originalRevert: reg delete "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules" /v NumberOfSIUFInPeriod /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

name: Disable Typing/Inking Collection
description: Stops Windows learning from your typing/handwriting.
detailedDescription: Stops Windows learning from your typing/handwriting.
originalCommand: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Personalization\Settings" /v AcceptedPrivacyPolicy /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization" /v RestrictImplicitTextCollection /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization" /v RestrictImplicitInkCollection /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization" /v RestrictImplicitTextCollection /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f & reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization" /v RestrictImplicitInkCollection /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

name: Disable Handwriting Sharing
description: Stops sharing handwriting error reports.
detailedDescription: Stops sharing handwriting error reports.

name: Disable CEIP
description: Customer Experience Improvement Program off.
detailedDescription: Customer Experience Improvement Program off.

name: Disable Telemetry Tasks
description: Disables the scheduled telemetry/appraiser tasks. Compatibility data stops being collected, so Windows may no longer warn you about a known-incompatible program before a feature update.
detailedDescription: Disables the scheduled telemetry/appraiser tasks. Compatibility data stops being collected, so Windows may no longer warn you about a known-incompatible program before a feature update.
originalCommand: schtasks /Change /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser" /Disable & schtasks /Change /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator" /Disable & schtasks /Change /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip" /Disable
originalRevert: schtasks /Change /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser" /Enable & schtasks /Change /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator" /Enable & schtasks /Change /TN "\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip" /Enable

name: Disable Error Reporting Service
description: Stops the WerSvc service. Crash reports are no longer collected, and a few programs use that service for their own crash dialog.
detailedDescription: Stops the WerSvc service. Crash reports are no longer collected, and a few programs use that service for their own crash dialog.
originalCommand: sc config WerSvc start= disabled & sc stop WerSvc

name: Disable Maps Broker
description: Stops the Downloaded Maps Manager service. Offline maps stop downloading and updating in the Maps app.
detailedDescription: Stops the Downloaded Maps Manager service. Offline maps stop downloading and updating in the Maps app.
originalCommand: sc config MapsBroker start= disabled & sc stop MapsBroker

name: Disable Remote Registry
description: Blocks remote registry access (more secure). Remote administration tools that reach the registry over the network stop working - almost never used at home.
detailedDescription: Blocks remote registry access (more secure). Remote administration tools that reach the registry over the network stop working - almost never used at home.
originalCommand: sc config RemoteRegistry start= disabled & sc stop RemoteRegistry

name: Disable LLMNR
description: Turns off Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution. Local devices without a DNS entry may stop being reachable by name, which some printers and NAS boxes rely on.
detailedDescription: Turns off Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution. Local devices without a DNS entry may stop being reachable by name, which some printers and NAS boxes rely on.

name: Set Default TTL 64
description: Standard TTL value for outgoing packets. This only restores the standard value; expect no measurable change in speed or latency.
detailedDescription: Standard TTL value for outgoing packets. This only restores the standard value; expect no measurable change in speed or latency.

name: Disable Teredo

name: Disable Background Recording
description: Stops Windows' own 'record last 30s' buffer fighting with OBS.
detailedDescription: Stops Windows' own 'record last 30s' buffer fighting with OBS.

name: Priority Upload for OBS
description: QoS rule that tags OBS traffic as priority - steadier live streams.
detailedDescription: QoS rule that tags OBS traffic as priority - steadier live streams.

operations.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if(-not (Get-NetQosPolicy -Name 'SlideTweaks OBS' -EA SilentlyContinue)){ New-NetQosPolicy -Name 'SlideTweaks OBS' -AppPathNameMatchCondition 'obs64.exe' -DSCPAction 46 -NetworkProfile All -EA SilentlyContinue }"

originalCommand: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if(-not (Get-NetQosPolicy -Name 'SlideTweaks OBS' -EA SilentlyContinue)){ New-NetQosPolicy -Name 'SlideTweaks OBS' -AppPathNameMatchCondition 'obs64.exe' -DSCPAction 46 -NetworkProfile All -EA SilentlyContinue }"

name: Chrome: No Background Apps
description: Stops Chrome running in the background after you close it.
detailedDescription: Stops Chrome running in the background after you close it.

name: Edge: No Background Apps
description: Stops Edge staying alive in the background.
detailedDescription: Stops Edge staying alive in the background.

name: Edge: Disable Startup Boost
description: Edge no longer preloads itself when Windows starts.
detailedDescription: Edge no longer preloads itself when Windows starts.

name: Games Priority Profile (MMCSS)
description: Gives games top GPU/CPU scheduling priority. Pairs with System Responsiveness. Games outrank everything else, so recording, streaming and voice chat get whatever is left.
detailedDescription: Gives games top GPU/CPU scheduling priority. Pairs with System Responsiveness. Games outrank everything else, so recording, streaming and voice chat get whatever is left.
originalCommand: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games" /v "GPU Priority" /t REG_DWORD /d 8 /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games" /v Priority /t REG_DWORD /d 6 /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games" /v "Scheduling Category" /t REG_SZ /d High /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games" /v "SFIO Priority" /t REG_SZ /d High /f
originalRevert: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games" /v "GPU Priority" /t REG_DWORD /d 8 /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games" /v Priority /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games" /v "Scheduling Category" /t REG_SZ /d Medium /f & reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games" /v "SFIO Priority" /t REG_SZ /d Normal /f

name: Block Driver Updates via Windows Update
description: Stops Windows overwriting your GPU driver with an older one.
detailedDescription: Stops Windows overwriting your GPU driver with an older one.

name: Wi-Fi Power Saving Off
description: Laptops: stops Windows throttling the Wi-Fi card (better ping).
detailedDescription: Laptops: stops Windows throttling the Wi-Fi card (better ping).

operations.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetAdapter -Physical | Where-Object { $_.MediaType -match '802.11' -or $_.Name -match 'Wi-Fi|WLAN|Wireless' } | ForEach-Object { Disable-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name $_.Name -NoRestart -EA SilentlyContinue }"

name: NVIDIA PowerMizer Off (Laptop)
description: Keeps an NVIDIA laptop GPU at full clocks instead of throttling down. Reboot.
detailedDescription: Keeps an NVIDIA laptop GPU at full clocks instead of throttling down. Reboot.

operations.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}' -EA SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match '^[0-9]{4}$' } | ForEach-Object { $d=(Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name DriverDesc -EA SilentlyContinue).DriverDesc; if($d -match 'NVIDIA'){ Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name PerfLevelSrc -Value 0x2222 -Type DWord -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name PowerMizerEnable -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name PowerMizerLevel -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name PowerMizerLevelAC -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force -EA SilentlyContinue } }"

originalCommand: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}' -EA SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match '^[0-9]{4}$' } | ForEach-Object { $d=(Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name DriverDesc -EA SilentlyContinue).DriverDesc; if($d -match 'NVIDIA'){ Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name PerfLevelSrc -Value 0x2222 -Type DWord -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name PowerMizerEnable -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name PowerMizerLevel -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name PowerMizerLevelAC -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force -EA SilentlyContinue } }"
originalRevert: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}' -EA SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match '^[0-9]{4}$' } | ForEach-Object { foreach($v in 'PerfLevelSrc','PowerMizerEnable','PowerMizerLevel','PowerMizerLevelAC'){ Remove-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name $v -EA SilentlyContinue } }"

name: Global Timer Resolution
description: Makes a game's high-resolution timer request apply system-wide again (pre-2004 behaviour). Reboot required. A system-wide high-resolution timer raises power draw and hurts standby on battery. Reboot required.
detailedDescription: Makes a game's high-resolution timer request apply system-wide again (pre-2004 behaviour). Reboot required. A system-wide high-resolution timer raises power draw and hurts standby on battery. Reboot required.
